target.kind: an agent-facing instruction file (a "skill") for the Claude Code harness
target.job: An agent loads this file and is expected to review or write user-interface code against the principles it lists. It is generated from JSON records and is not edited by hand.

judges.note: Ignores format and writes prose before its JSON; the runner extracts the last parseable object.
Honours the schema and often drops required fields anyway; it listed all 30 cards while reporting 24.
Local and lenient; its findings are often tautologies, but it converges on structural gaps.

excluded.reason: 4096-token context cannot hold a 25 KB artifact; it returns a verdict on whatever survived truncation.
Every seat in this rig authors with this model, so it cannot judge the work.
